record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: biholomorphic unstable slices across different maps
record.original_question: Given two generalized Hénon maps f1 and f2, under what circumstances can a local unstable slice of f1 be biholomorphically equivalent to an unstable slice of f2?

evidence.quote: Question 33. — Let f1, f2 be two generalized Hénon maps. Under which circumstances is it possible that some local unstable slice of f1 ... is biholomorphically equivalent to an unstable slice of f2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A generalized Hénon map is a polynomial automorphism of $\mathbb{C}^2$ of the form
$$f = f_d \circ f_{d-1} \circ \cdots \circ f_1, \qquad f_j(x,y) = (y,\, p_j(y) - a_j x),$$
where each $p_j \in \mathbb{C}[y]$ is a polynomial of degree $\ge 2$ and each $a_j \in \mathbb{C}^*$. For such an $f$, define the forward filled Julia set
$$K^+(f) = \{ z \in \mathbb{C}^2 : (f^n(z))_{n\ge 0} \text{ is bounded}\},$$
let $J^+(f) = \partial K^+(f)$, and for any saddle periodic point $p$ of $f$ let $W^u(p)$ denote its (one-dimensional, immersed) unstable manifold in $\mathbb{C}^2$. A local unstable slice of $f$ is a set of the form
$$K^+(f) \cap U,$$
where $U$ is a relatively open subset of an unstable manifold $W^u(p)$ for some saddle periodic point $p$ of $f$.

Problem. Given two generalized Hénon maps $f_1$ and $f_2$, determine necessary and sufficient conditions under which there exists a local unstable slice of $f_1$ that is biholomorphically equivalent (as a subset of a Riemann surface, via a biholomorphism between ambient open sets in the respective unstable manifolds carrying the two slices) to a local unstable slice of $f_2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in a published list of open problems on Hénon maps. Partial progress exists: recent work by F. Bacher (2024) shows that for certain associated Kato surfaces near infinity, biholomorphism of the Kato surfaces of two generalized Hénon maps $F, G$ is equivalent to conjugacy in $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbb{C}^2)$, answering a related question. Earlier work by R. Pal handles maps of the form $H_{a,P}$, showing necessary conditions (same degree and Jacobian). A full characterization for general $f_1, f_2$ does not appear to be established.

status_evidence.title: Hénon Maps: A List of Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Question 33 asks under which circumstances a local unstable slice of one generalized Hénon map can be biholomorphically equivalent to one of another.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open in a list of open problems.

status_evidence.title: Hénon maps with biholomorphic Kato surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Shows that the Kato surfaces associated to germs of F and G near infinity are biholomorphic iff F and G are conjugate in Aut(C^2), answering a related question from the survey.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on related biholomorphism questions for generalized Hénon maps.

status_evidence.title: Hénon mappings with biholomorphic escaping sets
status_evidence.snippet: R. Pal's work establishes necessary conditions (equal degree and Jacobian) and partial results for special families of Hénon maps.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier partial results on biholomorphism between dynamically defined sets of generalized Hénon maps.
